name: High School Science and Digital Learning Internship
what_you_do: Each summer, 15 Chicago-area high school students pick a Field Museum scientist or expert. They do a 5-week research project. They also learn digital media, tech and career skills.
who_can_apply: High school students from the Chicago area. The page does not list an age or grade rule. Only 15 are chosen.
duration: Mid-June to end of July, Monday to Thursday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. The page says to check back in early 2027 for next summer.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page in early 2027 for the application. If you have questions, write to digitalstudio@fieldmuseum.org.
notes: Interns work on site at the Field Museum on a set schedule. The page does not say whether a work permit is needed. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16 and refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
